file_purpose: Replication record for the simulated speed notebook. This checkout has no saved test metrics for a completed DopplerNet run, so every score is null.

data.features: Precomputed log-CQT when the simulator exported Common/cqt.npy

split: One scene per split, stratified by speed bin, about 70/15/15. Cached under experiments/test_dopplernet_sa_xpinn/setup_cache/ when a run has been started.
